R&D increase is warranted: our leads are meaningful but not insurmountable — Apex AI and Genesis Systems are within ~0.03-0.05 on General Capability. Coding and General Capability are likely the highest-value benchmarks for enterprise and developer customers, so we prioritize those more heavily.
